label: Bittersweet farewell
lyrics: Goodbye, sweet love, tears in my smile. Beautiful pain, blessed loss, lonely hope. Dream of you in the dark, alive but broken.

label: Hopeful sadness
lyrics: Lonely night, but hope still burns. Lost and broken, yet I dream. Pain and light, tears and joy, alive in the dark.

label: Contemplative
lyrics: I think and wonder, remember the time, maybe perhaps. Day after day, night follows night. Question without answer, time keeps passing.

label: Conflicted love
lyrics: Love and hate, sweet and broken, beautiful pain. Holding on, letting go, alive and dead at once. Hope and fear, joy and tears.

label: Quiet reflection
lyrics: Time moves slow, I remember the day. Wonder what was, maybe still is. Quiet thinking, soft questions, calm in the night.

label: Hurting but free
lyrics: Hurt me deep, but I'm free now, alive and broken. Pain made me bright, tears taught me hope. Lonely strong, dark light.

label: Wistful
lyrics: Remember when we were happy, sweet days now lost. Dream of the light, but cold remains. Beautiful past, lonely now.

label: Searching
lyrics: Wonder where, question why, think and remember. Maybe the day, perhaps the night, time will tell. Slow steps, calm breath.

label: Resilient grief
lyrics: Broken but blessed, lonely yet free. Tears and smile, pain and hope, dead and alive. Sad sweet light, dark beautiful day.

label: Ambiguous
lyrics: Maybe I love you, maybe I don't. Sweet pain, beautiful lost. Hope or fear, joy or tears, alive in the empty.
